name: Two-stroke twin, 250 cc road bike
notes: A 250 cc road twin of the late 1970s and 1980s kind: 54 x 54 mm (247 cc), crank pins 180 apart (one firing a half turn), reed valves into each crankcase, exhaust ports open 186 degrees with a power valve (174 below 6,500 rpm, up by 8,000), transfers 124, a chamber a cylinder tuned near 8,500 rpm, packed silencers. Redline 10,000. Published figures for the class: some 26 kW at 8,500 rpm (Yamaha RZ250: 35 PS at 8,500). Ports and pipes are judgement for the class, not the maker's drawings.

expect.note: the custom geometry's four-stroke derivation (core/layout.fm), which the two-stroke does not use: it fires once a turn a cylinder, evenly
